messages:
sasha: Quick idea 1 0 00 0 planning a compact "RefKit Lite" launch focused on rapid adoption: 1) 90-min live workshop, 2) three 10-15min micro-tutorials, 3) short reproducible benchmark and a single blog post. thoughts?

marco: love it. keep the micro-tutorials very focused: onboarding, small model perf tuning, simple caching. each one should be a single markdown with code + one gif.

anya: routing notes: signup should funnel to HubSpot as `refkit-lite` campaign; include a checkbox for "Im interested in Dedicated" so sales gets qualified leads. also add utm_source=social to all tweets.

devon: i can stand up ephemeral sandboxes for attendees. proposal: 50 concurrent T4-ish slots for 2hrs on workshop day, snapshot image + a forkable GitHub template. will need branch tag by EOD Thu.

marco: benchmark narrative: show three scenarios (dev laptop local, hosted API, cached pipeline on dedicated) with latency, p50/p95, and cost-per-1000-tokens. include exact commands to reproduce in `bench/`. keep plots tiny — one PNG.

anya: email flow: pre-event (tips + credentials), day-of (reminder + agenda), post-event (recording + repo + survey). follow-up sequence for leads tagged "enterprise" -> handoff to AE.

assets-bot: Uploaded hero image to #marketing-assets (refkit-lite-hero.png).

devon: ack. ill build a fallback video walkthrough in case live kiosks flake.

marco: i'll own bench scripts + a short README. sample command: `./bench/run.sh --model redwood/small --iters 100 --seq 256`. will include raw CSV outputs.

sasha: timelines: 
- copy + social pack by 5/2 
- bench artifacts and sample outputs by 5/4 
- demo env + snapshots by 5/7 
- hubspot form + email templates by 5/6
please reply yes/no to dates.

anya: yes to dates. i'll draft the nurture content.

marco: yes. aiming for reproducible notebook too.

devon: yes. will post deploy URL and credentials in vault.

sasha: great. small ask: add a line to the workshop invite about "what to bring" (laptop, GitHub account). i'll assemble the event page + CTA. :thumbsup:

assets-bot: Event created: RefKit Lite Workshop on 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC."
